name: Target Persona & Heuristics
description_text:
1) Make sure you have formed final project teams. Select a use case client for your Final Project 

Apply for a job at Nana's Green Tea on Indeed:  
https://www.indeed.com 

Create a Stock Ticker watchlist on MSN 
https://www.msn.com/

Order a Desktop Computer for home use on Dell 
https://www.dell.com

Choose your own
Find a professional site or application that has enough complexity and issues to solve

2) As a team, gather all of your heuristics findings into a single heuristics document that applies to your client. Remove any duplication and fill in any gaps as you see fit. If you choose your own client, you will need to create a lightweight heuristics document for it (+1 bonus points)

3) Adapt the use case for your target persona (below) to identify how it best applies for the Student Persona. Include Pain Points and User Goals for this persona as part of an intro section of your new heuristics doc. You will have time in class to align before submitting the assignment.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Note: If you wish as your final project to select a different client and use case, you are welcome to, but you as a team will need to build out a new Heuristics Doc from scratch first as part of this assignment. (Bonus +1 to your X/4 for this assignment)

Recommended Reading:
Rocket Surgery Made Easy: Chapters 1-2,4-5

lecture_alignment.definition: Designing systems and processes that automate repetitive tasks, reduce manual effort, and improve efficiency through intelligent orchestration.
